description: This file defines the implementation of an equality predicate (`EqPredicateImpl`) used within a query criteria framework in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract predicate class and implements an accept method for visitor pattern traversal.

classes.name: EqPredicateImpl
classes.description: Implementation of an equality predicate within the Ditto model query criteria framework, enabling comparison operations in query expressions.

methods.name: EqPredicateImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with a value against which equality will be tested.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Implements the visitor pattern, delegating to the provided PredicateVisitor's visitEq method with the predicate's value.
